chapters.title: Minimal surfaces
chapters.description: Variations, stability, minimal graphs, compactness with bounded index, and geometric inequalities.

chapters.title: Min-max theory
chapters.description: Pitts, cycle topologies, discrete fineness, almost minimizing limits, and existence.

chapters.title: Volume spectrum and Morse index
chapters.description: Cohomological sweepouts, Weyl asymptotics, multiplicity one, index, and abundance.

chapters.title: Geometric applications of min-max theory
chapters.description: Willmore energy, neck constructions, and low-width model results.

chapters.title: Constant mean curvature surfaces
chapters.description: Area with a volume term, almost embedded CMC hypersurfaces, and curvature networks.

chapters.title: Allen-Cahn and phase transitions
chapters.description: Diffuse-interface energies, their Euler-Lagrange equation, and geometric limits.

chapters.title: Obstacle problems
chapters.description: Initial model and variational inequality; free-boundary regularity is planned.

chapters.title: Mean curvature flows
chapters.description: Smooth flow, convex contraction, shrinking models, and Gaussian area; weak-flow theory is in development.

chapters.title: History
chapters.description: Sourced historical notes on the origins of GMT and the development of min-max theory.
